candidate_precondition: All six candidate file hashes and byte lengths matched the frozen comparison register; three new paths were absent and three existing active hashes matched the captured preintegration snapshot before promotion.

files.rationale: Adopt the candidate pure club-capability/runtime intersection; reject malformed flag types, unknown visibility, empty or duplicate normalized identities. Add optional explicit club/channel scope matching while preserving compatibility with unscoped typed snapshots.

Expand the candidate constructor smoke test into seven policy/widget regressions for empty registries, zero shell branches, standalone-only and Settings-only recovery, disabled-route/Home recovery and later enablement, malformed flags and club-disabled intersection.
Replace casting-based config enablement with the candidate pure fail-closed policy. Preserve all active routing/presentation metadata and expose only the snapshot-scope helper needed by the registry.

Adopt conditional indexed-shell construction and the built-in unavailable destination when no route is enabled. Extend initial fallback selection to the existing Settings shell branch while preserving the Home gate exemption and primary bottom-navigation set.

Adopt the candidate explicit-club-disable guard before specialized module overrides. Reject supplied wrong/malformed club or non-mobile channel scope. Preserve compile-time internal-admin control and current Club/Membership always-visible behavior when the club capability is enabled.
Expand the candidate standalone dependency-free policy check from 20 to 36 checks, including malformed values, blank/duplicate identities, unknown visibility and explicit wrong-club/channel scope.

Add six package-local integration regressions for club capability, explicit wrong or malformed scope, core-module override preservation, malformed optional flags, zero enabled modules and offline/legacy bootstrap.

scope_and_limitations: These checks verify shared module registration and router recovery. Runtime feature registration does not authorize backend operations.
Existing ClubModule and MembershipModule overrides remain always visible when their compile-time club capability is enabled; explicit compile-time false still excludes them in the shared registry.

Explicit raw club_id/channel metadata is checked. PlatformConfigSnapshot.toJson currently omits club_id; compatibility with those unscoped typed snapshots is retained, relying on the existing scoped fetch/cache. This integration does not prove provenance for an arbitrary unscoped snapshot.
Scoped tests include existing router recovery/transition goldens and registry/navigation/inventory tests. No physical device, hosted deployment, provider or whole-platform acceptance is claimed.
Local test logs are outside tracked source; their hashes and commands are retained here.
